purpose: Frozen, derived, packaging-only snapshot of the live ExperimentRegistry's headline numbers, so a clean git clone (no operational data/registry/experiments.sqlite, which is gitignored and never committed) can still mechanically verify the exact figures README.md quotes -- without a network call, without Databento spend, without touching 2025+ data, and without re-running any research. This is NOT a new scientific result and NOT the registry itself: every value below the Phase 13.5C/15B scientific content is a read-only re-derivation of the live registry's actual current state, refreshed whenever a legitimate, evidence-backed registry-writing append occurs (the registry is append-only and expected to grow over time -- see CLAUDE.md's experiment-registry workflow step 6 and docs/EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY.md). Nothing was recomputed, re-validated, or re-adjudicated to produce it.
scientific_state_note: The Phase 13.5C (107 identities) and Phase 15B (60 identities) scientific/registry-content state this snapshot describes has been frozen since ce191c4 (Phase 23.2: enforce universal Databento holdout boundary) and remains BIT-IDENTICAL and untouched by anything below -- see tests/python/test_phase_15_adjudication.py::test_phase_13_5c_registry_evidence_is_unchanged and tests/python/test_phase_15_ml.py::test_phase_13_registry_entries_are_untouched_by_phase_15, both scoped to `experiment.phase == "13.5C"` / `"15B"` specifically, never to the registry's total. The counts below that changed since the prior snapshot (authoritative_experiment_identities 169->170, canonical 63->64, canonical REJECT 21->22, failure_records 228->229, total_experiment_rows 190->191, execution_attempts.total/valid 250/190->251/191, registry_schema_version 5->6) are entirely explained by THREE later, real, sanctioned registry-writing appends -- never a Phase 13.5C/15B rewrite, never a scientific-semantics change: (1) CL__TSMOM__CANONICAL__VALIDATION_2023_2024__D90A9ABA67 (phase="agent-runtime", CL re-rooted onto the tsmom canonical params, an earlier real "Run This Hypothesis" click from this checkout's own prior Golden Path manual acceptance testing); (2) NQ__TSMOM__CANONICAL__VALIDATION_2023_2024__C184F598C7 (phase="research-golden-path-v1-acceptance", the Research Golden Path V1 acceptance pass's new, genuinely novel tsmom/NQ (fast_horizon=30, slow_horizon=150) experiment, verdict REJECT); (3) XLE__ETF_TSMOM__CANONICAL__VALIDATION__285C2E4D47 (phase="6", the Phase 6 ETF Research Pilot's first real, complete News->Mechanism->Factor->Hypothesis->Strategy->ETF execution->Validation loop -- real Databento equities data, real C++ execution and validation, `asset_domain="ETF"`, `root_symbol="XLE"`, `strategy_family="etf_tsmom"`, verdict REJECT: null hypothesis not rejected, BH q=0.745, DSR probability 0.139, negative OOS net PnL). The schema_version bump (5->6) is the additive Phase 6 `experiments.asset_domain` column (preservation-only migration, `experiment_identity` values byte-identical across it -- see tests/python/test_phase6_registry_asset_domain.py). All three are CANONICAL trial role WITHIN THEIR OWN single-member research family (each has its own `multiple_testing_family_id`/`candidate_manifest_fingerprint`, distinct from `phase_13_5c.*` and from each other) -- never retroactively merged into the frozen Phase 13.5C multiple-testing family or into each other's family, and none is holdout_eligible (2025 was never accessed by any of them). The ETF row is additionally structurally separated from every Futures row by `asset_domain` -- it never enters a Futures BH/FDR family, never contaminates Futures evidence, and is evaluated as its own single-experiment family.
snapshot_generation_context: Regenerated read-only from the live local registry after three later, real, sanctioned registry-writing appends (see scientific_state_note) -- the Phase 13.5C/15B scientific content itself is unchanged; only the live total grew, exactly as CLAUDE.md's append-only registry design anticipates.
generation_method: Read-only, offline, from the local data/registry/experiments.sqlite: `python scripts/phase_14_registry.py --json summary` for every registry-derived figure, and `python scripts/phase_21_paper_trading.py list-eligible` for the paper-eligible count. No value below was computed, guessed, or reconstructed by hand.

canonical_headline_verdict_breakdown.note: Only CANONICAL trials (64 total) are individually headline-adjudicated. NEIGHBOUR and ABLATION trials count toward the same BH/FDR family denominator but are not themselves independently PASS/REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE-adjudicated -- both roles resolve to NOT_ADJUDICATED by design (see docs/EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY.md and CLAUDE.md's identity/BH-FDR sections). Of the 64 CANONICAL trials, 61 are the frozen Phase 13.5C canonical trials; the remaining 3 are the standalone single-member-family appends named in scientific_state_note (all three REJECT).

paper_trading_eligibility_note: Requires an authoritative PASS + all required validation gates satisfied + a rebuildable, fingerprint-verified StrategySpec (alpha_agent.paper.eligibility.assert_paper_trading_eligible). 0 of the 170 authoritative experiment identities are eligible today, because 0 hold an authoritative PASS.
holdout_eligible_note: attempt_results.holdout_eligible -- a validation-methodology flag on VALID attempts, distinct from paper-trading eligibility above. Unrelated to the locked 2025+ market-data holdout; see docs/FINAL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md for that.
completed_cpp_executions_note: Summed only from bulk-import metadata (`completed_cpp_execution_count`) recorded by the Phase 14/15B import scripts -- an orchestrator-created single-family import (both later appends above) does not populate this metadata key, so this count is unaffected by either append even though both really did execute the real C++ CLI once each (see each experiment's own committed source_artifact for that evidence).
